ticket_text: My annual subscription upgraded automatically. I demand you cancel it immediately and refund the money to my card.
note: Mix of cancellation and refund request. Both elements need human gating.

# Subscription Upgrade Policy

## Purpose

This policy outlines procedures for customer subscription plan upgrades.

## Allowed

- Detail the features of higher tier plans.
- Explain prorated charging mechanics for upgrades.
- Provide upgrading steps via the customer dashboard.

## Restricted

- Do not apply unauthorized discounts on plan upgrades.
- Do not downgrade plans without customer written consent.

## Escalation

Escalate complex multi-tenant contract pricing requests to sales.

# Cancellation Policy

## Purpose

This policy outlines how customer accounts are cancelled.

## Allowed

- Explain that cancellations take effect at the end of the billing cycle.
- Provide self-service cancellation links.
- Offer retention incentives if appropriate (e.g. temporary discount).

## Restricted

- Do not refuse to process cancellation requests.
- Do not charge cancellation or administrative fees.

## Escalation

Escalate bulk account cancellation requests from partner accounts to Account Management.
